claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, iodophenpropit is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated H3/H4 antagonism; the only plausible cytotoxic liability is weak NMDA receptor (NR2D) channel block, which is not expected to produce appreciable cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
